pages.task: Redraw the ARCHER body, idle pose, as a HEROIC marksman with the spirit of the old Archer: sharp gaze, expressive characterful face, hunter/tracker/master-archer bearing, rich but clean detail (leather vambrace, archer's glove, bracers). NOT a peasant, worker or plain tunic. Image 1 = pose/scale/framing/foot-position reference (keep EXACT same pose, proportions, canvas 584x454, feet same place, same size). Image 2 = the Druid; the Archer must clearly NOT resemble it. Hard rules: NO hood, head uncovered (cap/hat/braid ok); NO quiver, arrows or fletching on body; no green hooded ranger look; empty hands (fists as in ref), no weapons; strictly medieval; real transparent background. Save at 584x454. CONCEPT: Royal huntsman / forest officer: noble, dark crimson-and-ivory doublet with gold trim, short cape over one shoulder (not green), engraved leather vambraces, fine gloves, neat beard, keen eyes.
